sections.title: Health
sections.description: Request rate, faults and latency of the deployed processes, their saturation and restarts, and recent error logs.

sections.title: Traffic
sections.description: Cookieless visitors to the project's frontends, counted by the platform's daily visitor hash: visitors, page views, bounce, top pages and channels, and JS errors per page view.

sections.title: Users
sections.description: The console's Users card in numbers: active, new and returning users over the last 7 days (whatever range is selected), daily active users and accounts.

panels.title: Visitors now
panels.description: Distinct visitors in the 5 minutes before the end of the range.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts'))
SELECT uniqExact((EnvId, h)) AS "Visitors now" FROM web WHERE ts >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

panels.title: Visitors
panels.description: Distinct visitor-days in the range: the platform counts a visitor with a daily hash it forgets, so one person on two days or two devices is two. The trend is each hour's.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts'))
SELECT uniqExact((EnvId, h)) AS "Visitors" FROM web
panels.trendSql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts'))
SELECT toStartOfHour(ts) AS hour, uniqExact((EnvId, h)) AS "Visitors" FROM web GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

panels.title: Page views
panels.description: page_viewed events in the range, and page views per visit (a visit ends after 30 minutes without an event).
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix)
SELECT sum(views) AS "Page views", round(sum(views) / nullIf(count(), 0), 2) AS "Views per visit" FROM visits

panels.title: Bounce rate
panels.description: The share of visits with exactly one page view and nothing else (Plausible's definition).
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix)
SELECT round(avg(views = 1 AND actions = 0), 4) AS "Bounce rate" FROM visits

panels.title: Top pages
panels.description: The five routes the most visitors viewed in the range.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts'))
SELECT Props['route'] AS route, uniqExact((EnvId, h)) AS "Visitors"
FROM web WHERE EventName = 'page_viewed'
GROUP BY route ORDER BY "Visitors" DESC, route LIMIT 5

panels.title: Top channels
panels.description: The five channels the most visitors came from: each visitor-day counted once, by the channel of its first visit.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts')),
visits AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, vix, min(ts) AS start, max(ts) AS stop,
         countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') AS views,
         countIf(EventName != 'page_viewed') AS actions,
         argMinIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS entry_route,
         argMaxIf(Props['route'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS exit_route,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['referrer_host']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref,
         argMinIf(Props['referrer_path'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS ref_path,
         argMinIf(lower(if(Props['utm_source'] != '', Props['utm_source'], Props['ref'])), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS src,
         argMinIf(lower(Props['utm_medium']), ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS med,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_campaign'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS campaign,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_term'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS term,
         argMinIf(Props['utm_content'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS content,
         argMinIf(Props['click_id'], ts, EventName = 'page_viewed') AS click,
         anyIf(Country, Country != '') AS country, anyIf(DeviceType, DeviceType != '') AS device,
         anyIf(Browser, Browser != '') AS browser, anyIf(OS, OS != '') AS os
  FROM (
    SELECT *, sum(brk) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS vix
    FROM (
      SELECT *, dateDiff('second',
               lagInFrame(ts, 1, ts - INTERVAL 1 HOUR) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId, h ORDER BY ts
                                                         ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), ts) > 1800 AS brk
      FROM web))
  GROUP BY EnvId, h, vix),
first AS (
  SELECT EnvId, h, toDate(max(stop)) AS d,
         argMin(multiIf(
  med IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid', 'paidsearch', 'paid_search') OR click IN ('google', 'microsoft'), 'Paid search',
  med IN ('paid_social', 'paidsocial', 'social_paid', 'paid-social') OR click IN ('meta', 'tiktok', 'linkedin'), 'Paid social',
  med IN ('display', 'banner', 'cpm', 'programmatic'), 'Display',
  med IN ('email', 'e-mail', 'e_mail', 'newsletter'), 'Email',
  med = 'affiliate', 'Affiliate',
  match(ref, '(^|\\.)(chatgpt\\.com|chat\\.openai\\.com|perplexity\\.ai|claude\\.ai|gemini\\.google\\.com|copilot\\.microsoft\\.com|you\\.com)$')
    OR src IN ('chatgpt.com', 'chatgpt', 'perplexity', 'claude'), 'AI assistants',
  med IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm')
    OR match(ref, '(^|\\.)(facebook|instagram|linkedin|lnkd|reddit|youtube|tiktok|pinterest|threads|bsky|mastodon|t)\\.(com|co|in|app|social|net)$|(^|\\.)(x\\.com|news\\.ycombinator\\.com)$'), 'Organic social',
  med = 'organic' OR match(ref, '(^|\\.)(google|bing|duckduckgo|yahoo|baidu|yandex|ecosia|brave|kagi|startpage|qwant)\\.'), 'Organic search',
  src != '' OR med != '', 'Other campaign',
  ref = '', 'Direct',
  'Referral'), start) AS channel,
         argMin(if(src != '', src, if(ref != '', ref, '(direct)')), start) AS source,
         argMin(entry_route, start) AS landing,
         argMin(ref, start) AS referrer, argMin(ref_path, start) AS referrer_path,
         argMin(src, start) AS utm_source, argMin(med, start) AS utm_medium, argMin(campaign, start) AS utm_campaign,
         argMin(term, start) AS utm_term, argMin(content, start) AS utm_content,
         argMin(country, start) AS country_code, argMin(device, start) AS device_type,
         argMin(browser, start) AS browser_name, argMin(os, start) AS os_name,
         count() AS n_visits, countIf(views = 1 AND actions = 0) AS bounces
  FROM visits GROUP BY EnvId, h)
SELECT channel, count() AS "Visitors"
FROM first GROUP BY channel ORDER BY "Visitors" DESC, channel LIMIT 5

panels.title: JS errors per 1,000 page views
panels.description: Browser errors (error_events, kept 14 days by default) per thousand page views in the range. The project's frontend dashboard has the errors, issues and web vitals.
panels.sql:
WITH web AS (
  SELECT Timestamp AS ts, EnvId, DayVisitor AS h, UserId, EventName, Props, Country, DeviceType, Browser, OS
  FROM product_events
  WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Client IN ('web', 'landing') AND DayVisitor != '' AND DeviceType != 'bot'
    AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_in', 'auth_signed_out', 'flag_evaluated', 'page_engaged', 'auth_accounts'))
SELECT round(1000 * (SELECT count() FROM error_events WHERE Timestamp >= {from:DateTime64(9)} AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))) / nullIf((SELECT countIf(EventName = 'page_viewed') FROM web), 0), 2) AS "Errors per 1,000 views"

panels.title: Active users
panels.description: Distinct users with any signed-in product event. Always the 7 days before the end of the range, whatever range is selected, beside the 7 days before them, as the Users card counts.
panels.sql:
SELECT (SELECT uniqExact((EnvId, UserId)) FROM product_events WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}) AS "Active users (7 days)",
       (SELECT uniqExact((EnvId, UserId)) FROM product_events WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS "Previous 7 days"

panels.title: New users
panels.description: Users who signed up; in an environment that reported no sign-up in the 90 days before, the users first seen, except those first seen within 7 days of the earliest event retained (they may be returning, and count as returning). No figure when nothing in the 7 days can be decided. Always the 7 days before the end of the range, whatever range is selected, beside the 7 days before them, as the Users card counts.
panels.sql:
SELECT (SELECT if((SELECT count() > 0 AND countIf(DecidedFrom < {to:DateTime64(9)}) = 0 FROM (SELECT EnvId, toUInt8(max(has_signup)) AS ReportsSignups, min(first_at) AS DataFrom,
       if(max(has_signup) = 1, toDateTime64(0, 9), min(first_at) + INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS DecidedFrom
FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
GROUP BY EnvId) WHERE EnvId IN (SELECT EnvId FROM product_events WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)})), NULL, (SELECT count() FROM (SELECT EnvId, UserId, if(reports = 1, signed_up_at, first_at) AS NewAt, reports AS ReportsSignups
FROM (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, first_at, signed_up_at, has_signup, max(has_signup) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS reports,
         min(first_at) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS data_from
  FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId))
WHERE has_signup = 1 OR (reports = 0 AND first_at >= data_from + INTERVAL 7 DAY)) WHERE NewAt >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY))) AS "New users (7 days)",
       (SELECT if((SELECT count() > 0 AND countIf(DecidedFrom < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY) = 0 FROM (SELECT EnvId, toUInt8(max(has_signup)) AS ReportsSignups, min(first_at) AS DataFrom,
       if(max(has_signup) = 1, toDateTime64(0, 9), min(first_at) + INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS DecidedFrom
FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
GROUP BY EnvId) WHERE EnvId IN (SELECT EnvId FROM product_events WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY)), NULL, (SELECT count() FROM (SELECT EnvId, UserId, if(reports = 1, signed_up_at, first_at) AS NewAt, reports AS ReportsSignups
FROM (
  SELECT EnvId, UserId, first_at, signed_up_at, has_signup, max(has_signup) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS reports,
         min(first_at) OVER (PARTITION BY EnvId) AS data_from
  FROM (
    SELECT EnvId, UserId, min(Timestamp) AS first_at, minIf(Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_signed_up') AS signed_up_at,
           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId))
WHERE has_signup = 1 OR (reports = 0 AND first_at >= data_from + INTERVAL 7 DAY)) WHERE NewAt >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 7 DAY))) AS "Previous 7 days"

    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId)
GROUP BY EnvId) WHERE EnvId IN (SELECT EnvId FROM product_events WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY)), NULL, (SELECT uniqExact((EnvId, UserId)) FROM product_events WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (EnvId, UserId) NOT IN (SELECT EnvId, UserId FROM (SELECT EnvId, UserId, if(reports = 1, signed_up_at, first_at) AS NewAt, reports AS ReportsSignups
FROM (

           toUInt8(countIf(EventName = 'auth_signed_up') > 0) AS has_signup
    FROM product_events
    WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId))
    GROUP BY EnvId, UserId))
WHERE has_signup = 1 OR (reports = 0 AND first_at >= data_from + INTERVAL 7 DAY)) WHERE NewAt >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 7 DAY - INTERVAL 7 DAY)))) AS "Previous 7 days"

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Accounts in the environment's identity instance, from the platform's daily snapshot; an environment with none shows its users seen in the last 90 days.
panels.sql:
SELECT sum(if(has_snapshot, snapshot, toInt64(seen))) AS "Accounts"
FROM (
    SELECT EnvId,
           countIf(EventName = 'auth_accounts' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 3 DAY) > 0 AS has_snapshot,
           argMaxIf(toInt64OrZero(Props['total']), Timestamp, EventName = 'auth_accounts' AND Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 3 DAY) AS snapshot,
           uniqExactIf(UserId, UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state') AS seen
    FROM product_events
    WHERE Timestamp >= {to:DateTime64(9)} - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)} AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND (EventName = 'auth_accounts' OR (UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state'))
    GROUP BY EnvId)

panels.title: Daily active users, last 30 days
panels.description: Distinct signed-in users each UTC day of the 30 days ending at the end of the range.
panels.sql:
SELECT toDate(Timestamp) AS day, uniqExact((EnvId, UserId)) AS "Daily active users"
FROM product_events
WHERE UserId != '' AND EventName NOT IN ('auth_signed_out', 'auth_accounts') AND Props['forge.kind'] != 'state' AND (empty({env_ids:Array(String)}) OR has({env_ids:Array(String)}, EnvId)) AND Timestamp >= toStartOfDay({to:DateTime64(9)}) - INTERVAL 29 DAY AND Timestamp < {to:DateTime64(9)}
GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
